behaviour: A Greek cheese made from the whey of sheep's or goat's milk. Fresh, it is soft, white and mild, and crumbles over salads and rusks. Aged and dried, it turns hard and salty and is grated.

contains.basis: It is a cheese made from whey and milk.
The whey it is made from comes from cheeses set with animal rennet.

safety.note: Animal rennet is taken from the stomach of a young calf, kid or lamb.
